Commandant, S.V.C.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 1
Date 1 - 1 - 16
1st January 1916.

Sir,

All troops in Shanghai, Woosung, and Sungkiang
were paid yesterday.

Ten soldiers were on 31st ultimo sent from the
Arsenal to Loh Ka Ts Koh 陸家嘴角, Pootung, to
assist the police in patrolling that district.

It is reported that all the rebels in Shanghai
have received instructions from their Headquarters
to hold themselves in readiness for immediate
movements.

Your obedient servant,
mimum armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. Jan 1
Seen by JLP
pages.zh:
上海万国商团司令
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 1 号
日期 1916 年 1 月 1 日

先生：

昨日，驻上海、吴淞及松江的所有部队均已发饷。

上月 31 日，十名士兵从兵工厂被派往浦东陆家嘴角，协助警察在该地区巡逻。

据报，上海的所有叛乱分子已收到其总部指令，要求他们做好准备，以便立即行动。

您忠实的仆人，
mimum armstrong
首席侦探督察

警务处总监

于 1 月 1 日录入 M.S.
JLP 阅
